characters.name: Fin
characters.voice_notes: Zei's best friend. Easygoing, joking, loyal and protective; bored by school, later enthusiastic about linguistics and the Bansunpei language project.

characters.name: Zei
characters.age: teen (final year of high school, about 17-18)
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego chapters (full name Zei Leimin). Very bright maths/physics mind, quick and articulate, dry humour, nonchalant about danger, competitive Minpentai player; socially a bit awkward. Devoted to his mother Min.

characters.name: restaurant robot
characters.voice_notes: Serving robot that speaks a deliberately cute, sing-song Dzegoban; the narrator supplies the translation.

characters.name: Mu
characters.age: older adult (described as an older woman)
characters.voice_notes: Minpentai tournament organiser/mentor who knows Zei and Bai and is close to the game's rule-setters. Warm and teasing, but shrewd, measured and knowing; turns grave and lecturing in ch. 7.

characters.name: Bai
characters.age: teen (same age as Zei, final year of high school)
characters.voice_notes: Zei's Minpentai rival (full name Bai Jahen). Confident, taunting, proud and well-travelled; softens into grudging respect and an obvious fondness for Zei.

characters.name: loud automated voice
characters.voice_notes: Stern, loud arena PA voice giving the Minpentai countdowns in Dzegoban (all capitals); mechanical and commanding, not cute.

characters.name: tournament announcer
characters.voice_notes: Minpentai tournament master of ceremonies addressing a large audience; showman-like, dramatic sports-announcer delivery.

notes: No letter is shared within the chapter. 4:64 (F) is a written message from Fin in Dzegoban (translated by the narrator at 4:66). 4:22 (R) is the restaurant robot speaking cute Dzegoban. L runs (4:92, 4:94, 4:96, 4:106, 4:109, 4:113, 4:114) are the stern arena countdown voice in Dzegoban; A runs (4:97-4:99) are the tournament announcer's welcome in plain language - I kept these as two voices, though the text does not rule out their being the same PA voice. In 4:92 and 4:94 the trailing narrator run starts with a stray full stop. The robotic voices mentioned at 4:85 and 4:86 are reported indirectly and have no runs. 4:140 is Zei speaking over the team audio channel.
